reports.title: GILEAD SCIENCES ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Guidance and Outlook
section: For the full year 2026, Gilead now expects:

(in millions, except per share amounts) | October 29, 2026 Guidance
Low End | High End | Comparison to August 4, 2026 Guidance
Product sales | 31,000 | 31,300 | Previously $30,100 to $30,400
Product sales excluding Veklury | 30,700 | 31,000 | Previously $29,800 to $30,100
Veklury | ~ $300 | Unchanged
Diluted loss per share | (4.40) | (4.05) | Previously $(3.75) to $(3.40)
Non-GAAP diluted loss per share | (1.20) | (0.85) | Previously $(0.65) to $(0.30)

Our full year 2026 GAAP and non-GAAP diluted loss per share guidance includes the impact of approximately $9.88 due to acquired IPR&D charges of $12.4 billion related to the Arcellx, Tubulis, Ouro Medicines and PepStar transactions announced this year, net of the impact of the Lakefront collaboration and related taxes.
